LINES OF FORCE
Berserker (level 1)

You redirect the energy of motion.

Magic

Triggered Action
Distance

Melee 1

Target

Self or one creature

Trigger

The target would be force moved.

You can select a new target of the same size or smaller within distance to be force moved instead. You become the source of the forced movement, determine the new target’s destination, and can push the target instead of using the original forced movement type. Additionally, the forced movement distance gains a bonus equal to 2.

1PT

The forced movement distance gains a bonus equal to 4 instead.
